verdict.rationale: Mintlify's docs describe a pull-request review flow: per-PR preview URLs let reviewers see changes live before merging (mintlify-docs-17). The editor lets teams share changes, then approve and merge pull requests before they reach the live site (mintlify-docs-12, mintlify-docs-25), and agent-authored changes arrive as PRs for team review (mintlify-docs-4). Missing for 10: explicit evidence of teammates leaving review comments (the only comment mention is the AI agent leaving comments and suggestions), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the review and approval workflow.
